cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank (MR30 = 31,000/day). Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. Rank-ups require a sacrifice of credits + items.
description: Grineer defectors fighting their former masters. The soldier's syndicate — straightforward, honor-bound, and home to one of the best shotguns in the game.
fastest: Daily missions + all 8 medallions every day, sigil worn at all times. Medallions are the real farm — they bypass the cap.
name: Steel Meridian

rewards.name: Vaykor Hek
rewards.why: One of the best shotguns in the game — huge pellets, Justice syndicate proc. Buy the blueprint at max rank.

rewards.name: Vaykor Marelok
rewards.why: Hard-hitting secondary with the Justice effect; solid early Steel Path sidearm.

rewards.name: Health Conversion
rewards.why: THE reason many players rank Steel Meridian: +1350 armor stacking with health orbs. Core survivability mod.

rewards.name: Scattered Justice
rewards.why: Hek augment — +200% multishot turns the regular Hek into a monster for new players.

rewards.name: Justice Blades
rewards.why: Dual Cleavers augment with the Justice AoE proc — fun and strong.

standing_how: Equip the Steel Meridian sigil and play normally — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing.
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions from the Syndicate console (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission (bronze 500 / silver 1000 / gold 1500). Medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) at the relay enclave for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. Rank-ups require a sacrifice of credits + items.
description: Warrior-monks seeking truth through discipline and combat. The most popular syndicate pick for one reason: Arcane Energize.
fastest: Daily missions + all 8 medallions every day, sigil worn at all times. Medallions bypass the cap — this is how people max a syndicate in ~2 weeks.
name: Arbiters of Hexis

rewards.name: Arcane Energize
rewards.why: The single most important arcane for ability-spam builds — energy on orb pickup. Rank 5 sells for hundreds of platinum; farm rank 5 Arbiters just for this.

rewards.name: Arcane Grace
rewards.why: Health regen on damage taken — core survivability arcane for warframes.

rewards.name: Arcane Barrier
rewards.why: Shield restore on damage — great for shield-gating builds.

rewards.name: Telos Boltor
rewards.why: Accurate, hard-hitting rifle with the Truth syndicate proc (energy restore).

rewards.name: Telos Akbolto
rewards.why: Twin pistols with the Truth proc — solid crit secondary.

rewards.name: Bladed Rounds
rewards.why: Arbiters weapon augment — big damage boost on kill for rifles.

standing_how: Equip the Arbiters of Hexis sigil and play normally — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing.
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions from the Syndicate console (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission (bronze 500 / silver 1000 / gold 1500). Medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) at the relay enclave for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. Wearing one syndicate's sigil also earns half standing for allies and LOSES standing with enemies — plan your pair.
description: A curious, obsessive Cephalon hungry for knowledge. Allied with the Arbiters, so most players level these two together.
fastest: Level alongside Arbiters of Hexis (ally): wear one sigil, gain for both. Daily missions + 8 medallions each.
name: Cephalon Suda

rewards.name: Synoid Simulor
rewards.why: The infamous black-hole gun — group enemies and detonate. Still a fantastic crowd-control weapon.

rewards.name: Synoid Gammacor
rewards.why: Beam secondary with the Entropy proc — great early-mid game beam weapon.

rewards.name: Neutron Star
rewards.why: Nova augment — her Antimatter Drop becomes a nuke. Core Nova build piece.

rewards.name: Thermagnetic Shells
rewards.why: Detron augment adding the Entropy proc — makes the Detron punch far above its weight.

standing_how: Equip the Cephalon Suda sigil — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing (also gains half for allied Arbiters).
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission — medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. You can be max rank in 3 syndicates at once via the two allied pairs + one neutral (e.g. Suda/Arbiters + Perrin/Loka leaves one slot free).
description: Corpus defectors who believe profit and peace can coexist. Allied with New Loka — the classic second pair alongside Suda/Arbiters or Meridian/Veil.
fastest: Level alongside New Loka (ally). Daily missions + 8 medallions each; keep the sigil on during all normal play.
name: The Perrin Sequence

rewards.name: Secura Lecta
rewards.why: THE credit-farming melee — bonus credits on kill with the Sequence proc. Every credit farm uses this.

rewards.name: Secura Penta
rewards.why: Grenade launcher with the Sequence proc — fun and strong AoE.

rewards.name: Energy Conversion
rewards.why: Key mod for ability-nuke builds — +50% ability strength after picking up an energy orb.

rewards.name: Sequence Burn
rewards.why: Gammacor augment adding the Sequence AoE proc — makes the beam gun clear rooms.

standing_how: Equip the Perrin Sequence sigil — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing (also gains half for allied New Loka).
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission — medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. Rank-ups need credits + a sacrifice.
description: Fanatical purifiers who see corruption everywhere. Allied with Steel Meridian — the classic first pair for new players.
fastest: Level alongside Steel Meridian (ally). Daily missions + 8 medallions each; sigil on during all normal play.
name: Red Veil

rewards.name: Rakta Cernos
rewards.why: Bow with the Blight proc that restores ENERGY — one of the best energy-economy weapons for bow builds.

rewards.name: Rakta Ballistica
rewards.why: Burst crossbow sidearm with the Blight energy proc.

rewards.name: Rakta Dark Dagger
rewards.why: Radiation dagger with Blight — pairs with shield-gating melee builds.

rewards.name: Concealed Explosives
rewards.why: Red Veil augment — thrown secondaries explode. Meme-tier fun, real damage.

standing_how: Equip the Red Veil sigil — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing (also gains half for allied Steel Meridian).
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission — medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Medallion turn-ins are NOT capped. Tip: you cannot be allied with all 6 — pick your two pairs (e.g. Meridian/Veil + Suda/Arbiters) and optionally a third via the remaining neutrals.
description: Militant purists who revere a 'pure' humanity. Allied with the Perrin Sequence — level them as a pair.
fastest: Level alongside the Perrin Sequence (ally). Daily missions + 8 medallions each; sigil on during all normal play.
name: New Loka

rewards.name: Sancti Tigris
rewards.why: Double-barrel shotgun nuke with the Purity proc (health restore) — deletes Steel Path trash.

rewards.name: Sancti Magistar
rewards.why: Hammer with lifesteal on heavies — pairs beautifully with the Magistar Incarnon.

rewards.name: Growing Power
rewards.why: Aura mod: +25% ability strength for 6s after a status proc. A staple in strength builds.

rewards.name: Winds of Purity
rewards.why: Furis augment with lifesteal — turns the Furis into a healing hose.

standing_how: Equip the New Loka sigil — 2.25% of affinity earned becomes standing (also gains half for allied Perrin Sequence).
Run the 3 daily Syndicate missions (highest Mastery tier gives the most).
Find all 8 medallions hidden in each mission — medallion turn-ins IGNORE the daily standing cap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank, shared across all open-world turn-ins.
description: The fisher-folk of Cetus. Your gateway to Zaws, Gara, and the amp parts pipeline — rank this early.
fastest: Max-level Konzu bounties on repeat. Supplement with bulk fish turn-ins (bait + Murkray during night).
name: Ostrons
rep: Konzu (bounties), Fisher Hai-Luk (fish), Old Man Suumbaat (gems), Hok (zaws)

rewards.name: Zaw parts (Hok's Anvil)
rewards.why: Build custom modular melee weapons — some of the best melee in the game (e.g. plague kripath zaw). Requires Ostron rank for parts.

rewards.name: Exodia arcanes (Hok's Anvil)
rewards.why: Zaw-only arcanes — Exodia Contagion turns zaws into projectile nukes.

rewards.name: Gara parts
rewards.why: Glass warframe — her parts drop from Cetus bounties across tiers.

rewards.name: Amp parts pipeline
rewards.why: Higher Ostron rank unlocks the Quills crossover — you need Quills standing to build real amps, and Ostron rank gates early progress.

standing_how: Run Konzu's bounties — highest-level bounty gives the most standing. This is the fastest method.
Catch fish on the Plains and turn them in to Fisher Hai-Luk (night fish like Murkray and Glappid give big standing).
Mine gems and turn them in to Old Man Suumbaat.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.
type: Open World — Cetus / Plains of Eidolon

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires Saya's Vigil + The War Within. Quills rank gates amp part tiers — rank 5 (Adherent) unlocks the 7-series parts.
description: The mysterious Unum's servants. If you fight Eidolons, this is the most important syndicate in the game — amps and operator arcanes live here.
fastest: Tridolon hunts — a full 3x3 night yields dozens of Exceptional/Flawless cores. Convert cores the moment you cap daily standing.
name: The Quills

rewards.name: Amp parts (777 amp)
rewards.why: Build the meta 7-7-7 amp (or 1-7-7 for Eidolons) — a real amp multiplies your operator damage 10x over the mote amp. Required for serious Eidolon hunting.

rewards.name: Virtuos arcanes
rewards.why: Amp arcanes — Virtuos Strike (crit on void damage), Virtuos Fury, Virtuos Shadow. Core to amp builds.

rewards.name: Magus arcanes
rewards.why: Operator arcanes — Magus Elevate (heal on transfer), Magus Lockdown (tether mines), Magus Husk/Vigor (survivability).

rewards.name: Quills rank unlocks
rewards.why: Each rank unlocks higher-tier prisms/scaffolds/braces — you cannot build a 777 amp without max Quills.

standing_how: Hunt Eidolons on the Plains at night and turn in Sentient Cores (Intact 100 / Exceptional 500 / Flawless 1500) to Quill Onkko.
Faster: run the Teralyst → Gantulyst → Hydrolyst (tridolon) in a group — cores rain.
Solo shortcut: Vomvalysts drop Intact cores; farm them with a mote amp to bootstrap.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.
type: Open World — Cetus / Plains of Eidolon

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires Vox Solaris quest + The War Within. Rank 5 (Agent) unlocks everything.
description: The underground resistance inside Fortuna. Toroids are the currency — and the rewards include Hildryn, Baruuk, and kitgun arcanes.
fastest: Profit-Taker Phase 4 runs (each drops Crisma toroids worth 6k standing) once you can kill it fast; before that, Temple of Profit toroid farm.
name: Vox Solaris

rewards.name: Baruuk parts
rewards.why: The pacifist monk warframe — main blueprint and components bought from Little Duck.

rewards.name: Hildryn main blueprint
rewards.why: Shield-tank warframe — buy the main BP from Little Duck, parts from the Exploiter Orb.

rewards.name: Pax arcanes
rewards.why: Kitgun arcanes — Pax Bolt (fire rate), Pax Charge (efficiency), Pax Seeker (ricochet headshots), Pax Soar (aim glide). Essential for kitgun builds.

rewards.name: Gravimag
rewards.why: Lets you use Arch-guns as heavy weapons on the ground — required for Profit-Taker.

standing_how: Farm toroids and turn them in to Little Duck: Vega (Spaceport), Calda (Temple of Profit), Sola (Enrichment Labs) = 1,000 each; Crisma (Profit-Taker / Exploiter Orb) = 6,000.
Fastest farm: Profit-Taker Orb Phase 4 speedruns drop Crisma toroids; or Temple of Profit with Nekros + resource booster.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires the Vox Solaris quest.
description: The K-drive punks of Fortuna. A small syndicate — quick to max, and the only source of K-drive mods.
fastest: Run every race on the map once daily — the full circuit takes ~10 minutes and hits the cap easily.
name: Ventkids

rewards.name: K-drive mods
rewards.why: The only source — mods for speed, tricks, and race performance. Required to complete your K-drive collection.

rewards.name: Custom K-drives
rewards.why: Build your own boards with unique stats and styles at the clubhouse.

rewards.name: Ventkids cosmetics
rewards.why: Boards, sigils, and flair exclusive to the syndicate.

standing_how: Complete K-drive races across the Orb Vallis — each race grants standing once per day per race.
Do tricks (grinds, airs, grabs) while riding for trick points that convert to standing.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Rank 5 (Old Mate) unlocks the Profit-Taker bounty.
description: The cyborg workers of Fortuna. Debt-bonds are the currency — and Ticker lets you buy standing with credits.
fastest: Buy bonds from Ticker with credits — check his stock daily and buy every cheap bond. This is the only syndicate you can max with credits alone.
name: Solaris United

rewards.name: Garuda parts
rewards.why: The blood warframe — parts drop from Vallis bounties across tiers.

rewards.name: Kitgun parts (Rude Zuud)
rewards.why: Build custom modular secondaries — kitguns like Tombfinger and Rattleguts are top-tier.

rewards.name: Moa companions (Legs)
rewards.why: Build custom robotic companions with unique precepts.

rewards.name: Profit-Taker access
rewards.why: Rank 5 unlocks the Profit-Taker Orb bounty — your toroid and credit farm.

standing_how: Run Eudico's bounties — they award debt-bonds (Training, Shelter, Medical, Advances, Familial).
Turn debt-bonds in to Thursby for standing (higher-tier bonds = more standing).
FASTEST: buy debt-bonds from Ticker for credits — pure credit-to-standing conversion, no grind.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires the Heart of Deimos quest.
description: The infested Orokin family of Deimos. Tokens are the currency — earn them from each family member's activity.
fastest: Rotate bounties + conservation for Son tokens; bulk-turn tokens to Grandmother. Mother bounties also drop Xaku parts while you farm.
name: Entrati
rep: Grandmother (token turn-ins), Mother, Father, Son, Daughter, Otak

rewards.name: Helminth Segment
rewards.why: Unlocks the Helminth system — subsume warframe abilities onto other frames. The single biggest account-power unlock on Deimos.

rewards.name: Necramech parts (Father)
rewards.why: Damaged Necramech parts to build your Voidrig — required for Orphix missions and New War.

rewards.name: Xaku parts
rewards.why: The broken warframe — parts drop from Deimos bounties; blueprints at the syndicate.

rewards.name: Trumna / Sepulcrum blueprints
rewards.why: Infested rifle and kitgun-style pistol blueprints from Father — strong, unique weapons.

rewards.name: Theorem arcanes
rewards.why: From Isolation Vaults — Theorem Infection/Demulcent/Contagion buff weapon damage via ability kills.

standing_how: Earn family tokens and turn them in to Grandmother: Mother (bounties), Father (Deimos bounties/crafting), Son (conservation — tranquilize infested wildlife), Daughter (fishing), Otak (mining).
Fastest token: Son tokens from conservation, or buy fish/gem parts cheap and trade up.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires Heart of Deimos + The War Within.
description: Albrecht Entrati's loyal cephalon servant. The home of Necramech mods and Voidrig weaponry.
fastest: Tier 3 Isolation Vaults on repeat — matrices drop from vault completion and necramech kills.
name: Necraloid

rewards.name: Necramech mods
rewards.why: The ONLY source — Necramech Rage, Redirection, Steel Fiber, Repair, Slipstream, Hydraulics. Your mech is paper without these.

rewards.name: Morgha blueprint
rewards.why: Voidrig's arch-cannon — massive AoE arch-gun.

rewards.name: Cortege blueprint
rewards.why: Voidrig's beam arch-gun — melts crowds.

rewards.name: Bonewidow parts
rewards.why: The sword-and-shield necramech — parts available here.

standing_how: Run Isolation Vaults and Arcana bounties for Orokin Matrices, then turn them in to Loid.
Higher-tier vaults (Tier 3) give the most matrices per run.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires the Angels of the Zariman quest.
description: The last crew of the Zariman. Voidplumes are the currency — and this is where Incarnon weapons and Arcane Dissolution live.
fastest: Bounty rotation + Voidplume hunting in Exterminate/Cascade missions. Plumes bypass nothing but stack fast — a good run can net 10k+.
name: The Holdfasts

rewards.name: Incarnon weapon blueprints (Cavalero)
rewards.why: Laetum, Phenmor, Felarx, Innodem, Praedos — the original Incarnon weapons, all top-tier. MR14 to buy.

rewards.name: Arcane Dissolution (Quinn)
rewards.why: Melt unwanted arcanes into Vosfor, then spend Vosfor on arcane packs — the arcane economy runs through here.

rewards.name: Gyre parts
rewards.why: The electric warframe — parts from Zariman missions/bounties.

rewards.name: Holdfast arcanes
rewards.why: Arcane packs can drop Zariman arcanes like Arcane Steadfast, Reaper, Blessing.

standing_how: Run Yonta's bounties on the Zariman for standing.
Collect Voidplumes hidden in Zariman missions (Pinion 500 / Down 1000 / Vane 2000 / Crest 2000 / Quill 5000) and turn them in to Quinn.
Voidplume Quills (5,000) spawn in Angel fights and Cascades — learn the spawn spots.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.
type: Open World — Chrysalith / Zariman Ten Zero

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank. Requires the Whispers in the Walls quest.
description: Albrecht Entrati's uplifted lab animals — a fish, a bird, and a cat thing guarding his laboratories. The Whispers in the Walls syndicate.
fastest: Bounty rotation + Voca turn-ins. Echo Voca (2,000 each) from higher-tier missions adds up fast.
name: Cavia

rewards.name: Qorvex parts (Bird 3)
rewards.why: The concrete warframe — buy his parts with standing instead of praying to bounty RNG.

rewards.name: Incarnon blueprints
rewards.why: Albrecht's Incarnon weapons drop from Disruption Armatus rotation or can be bought from Loid for Vessel Capillaries.

rewards.name: Arcane Dissolution (Loid)
rewards.why: Second dissolution vendor — melt arcanes and buy arcane packs (includes Duviri, Holdfast, and Eidolon arcane sets).

rewards.name: Dante parts
rewards.why: The tome warframe — parts from Disruption Armatus; standing shop covers what RNG won't.

rewards.name: Bird 3 mods & arcanes
rewards.why: Exclusive mods, arcanes, and decorations from the wares vendor.

standing_how: Run Fibonacci's Albrecht's Laboratories bounties for standing.
Collect Voca in missions (Shrill 500 / Bellow 1,000 / Echo 2,000) and turn them in for standing.
Run Netracells via Tagfer — weekly high-value mission with big rewards.
Turn in Universal Medallions (from Disruption) for 1,000 standing each.
type: Open World — Sanctum Anatomica / Albrecht's Laboratories

cap_note: Weekly mission + Stock shop. Requires the Veilbreaker quest.
description: Kahl's Grineer resistance crew. Weekly missions, a weekly Archon Shard, and Styanax — low effort, huge value.
fastest: Do the weekly mission every week — takes ~15 minutes. Grab all Stock caches on the way.
name: Kahl's Garrison

rewards.name: Archon Shard (weekly)
rewards.why: ONE Archon Shard per week from Chipper — the most reliable shard source in the game. Never skip a week.

rewards.name: Styanax parts
rewards.why: The spear-throwing warframe — main blueprint and components bought with Stock.

rewards.name: Archon mods
rewards.why: Chipper sells the Archon mod set (Continuity, Stretch, Vitality, Intensify, Flow) — corrupted-style mods with bonus effects.

rewards.name: Veilbreaker cosmetics
rewards.why: Kahl-themed armor, sigils, and decorations.

standing_how: Complete Kahl's weekly 'Break Narmer' veil-breaker mission (resets weekly).
Collect Stock (the currency) in the mission — hidden caches and objectives.
Spend Stock at Chipper's shop in the Drifter's Camp.
No daily cap pressure — it's a weekly loop, not a daily grind.

cap_note: Daily cap = 1,000 + 1,000 per Mastery Rank for bounties; Hex Treasure turn-ins are NOT capped. Requires The Hex quest. Ranks: Leftovers → Fresh Slice → 2-For-1 → Hot & Fresh → Pizza Party.
description: The six Protoframes of 1999 — Arthur, Aoi, Amir, Quincy, Leticia, and Eleanor. Complete The Hex quest to unlock.
fastest: Bounty loop + treasure cache hunting. Treasures bypass the daily cap, so a dedicated treasure run day can push multiple ranks.
name: The Hex
rep: Arthur (rank-ups), Amir (weapons), Eleanor (arcanes), Leticia (treasures), Aoi (somachords), Quincy (cosmetics)

rewards.name: Cyte-09 parts (Amir)
rewards.why: The 1999 sniper warframe — blueprint and components from Amir.

rewards.name: AX-52 / Vesper 77 / Reconifex (Amir)
rewards.why: 1999-era weapons — the AX-52 rifle, Vesper 77 pistol, and Reconifex.

rewards.name: Arcane Enhancements (Eleanor)
rewards.why: Eleanor sells the 1999 arcane set — new build-defining arcanes.

rewards.name: Coda weapons
rewards.why: Eleanor is the first port of call for Coda weapons — the new 1999 weapon line.

rewards.name: 1999 cosmetics (Quincy/Aoi)
rewards.why: Protokol skins, sigils, glyphs, somachords, and Captura scenes.

standing_how: Run Hex bounties from the mall's bounty board.

Collect Hex Treasures in Höllvania missions and turn them in to Leticia: Big Bytes Pizza 2,500 / Argon Burger Meal 1,500 / 35mm Film, Cheddar Crowns, Mood Crystal, Chuggin' Along Sixpack, On-Lyne CD, Countessa Comic 750 each.
Treasure turn-ins BYPASS the daily standing cap — farm treasures to rank far faster than the cap allows.
Hunt treasure caches with Xaku + loot radar — they emit a sound cue.
